headline: Bessent, US Treasury: "Joint Intervention from January Under Review... Additional Intervention Also Possible"
summary: The first joint US-Japan yen purchase in 28 years was reportedly a scenario prepared since early this year, not an improvised response. Bessent said additional intervention is possible.
why: The yen is a major funding and reserve currency, and Japanese market instability can spread to US Treasuries given Japan's large holdings of US debt.
why_moved: Officials said the intervention was a planned scenario aimed at limiting spillovers from Japan's markets, and that further action is possible. This signals official willingness to defend the yen.
